summary: The WCB file is part of the HSPnet.UserControls.Enrollment system and involves various operations related to course enrollments and student data management, including WCB waiver processes.
purpose: The purpose of the WCB system is to manage student enrollments and perform operations related to WCB waivers, ensuring accurate data handling and appropriate user interface adjustments based on user interactions and data states.

workflows.name: Manage Enrollment
steps: Check and change WCB waiver statuses.
Use the grid for data presentation and interaction.
Edit or update enrollment details as needed.

business_rules: WCB waiver status affects button visibility.
Editable screen if the student is not graduated, inactive, or waived.
If a row is disabled, editing is not allowed.
validations: Ensure StudentEmail and StudentName fields are not null.
The enrollment ID must be greater than zero to unlock certain actions.
conditions: RowDisabled if the student is graduated or inactive.
system_behavior: Controls display and behavior based on user session and data context.
JavaScript is set up dynamically based on grid data interactions.
The grid sorts data by last name initially if not sorted already.
dependencies: Depends on user session for data access and operations.
exceptions: Grid hides buttons if data is not editable.
Cancellation of data operations if user session is null.
